overview.title: Material overview
overview.subtitle: {{total}} pieces of material in total. Pick a folder on the left to see what is inside.
overview.emptySubtitle: No material yet. Drop a few real documents into the folders below — the AI only uses facts from here.
overview.tip: The AI takes every fact from these folders. The more real and specific the material, the better the output.

guide.root: The material root of this project. Background goes in background, publishing angles in angles, generated drafts in drafts, images in media.
guide.background: Background material goes here and it all has to be real and factual. It is split into product info, website copy, user feedback and legal text.
guide.backgroundProduct: Product introductions, feature descriptions, pricing and changelogs — anything that explains what the product actually is.
guide.backgroundWebsite: Website copy, landing pages and help-center articles. One page per file.
guide.backgroundFeedback: User feedback, app-store reviews, complaints and support chats. Keep the bad ones too, they are the most useful.
guide.backgroundLegal: Privacy policy, terms of service and compliance notices, kept word for word.
guide.angles: One file per publishing angle: who it is for, what it says, what tone it uses and where it gets posted.
guide.drafts: Generated drafts waiting to be published, together with the material and the angle each one came from.
guide.media: Original images. Uploading an image also writes a card file next to it with the OSS URL and the dimensions.
guide.generic: A folder you created yourself. Whatever goes in here is treated as fact about this project.

angles.title: Publishing angles
angles.subtitle: An angle is a hypothesis to test, not a category. Push the ones that work deeper, retire the ones that stall.

empty.desc: Angles are meant to be tested, not locked in up front: start with a few candidates, publish, read the numbers, push the good line deeper and drop the rest.

platformRule.xhs: Xiaohongshu: title up to 20 characters, body up to 1000, at most 10 topics.
platformRule.douyin: Douyin: a short title works best, keep the body tight, do not pile on topics.
platformRule.wxSph: WeChat Channels: one line that makes the hook clear, short description.
platformRule.wxGzh: WeChat Official Account: the title has to stand on its own, the body can run long, write in paragraphs.
